canonicalization: whole validation then bounded same generic MLIR print and identity optimize. denseStaticProof.credit: no checks removed by this proof; no execution, physical storage, alias escape, general static safety or Main25 completion
denseStaticProof.domain: per-function finite source/IR proof only: exact nonnegative length or unknown, keyed by unique root allocation site; aliases share that root; separate creates never merge even for equal bits
denseStaticProof.failure: Source private located static semantic rejection at original index/newLength expression; cold self-consistent packets and Core must independently reject proven literal gap/growth; all parameter/unknown states retain future reach-time checks
denseStaticProof.initial: new literal establishes exact element count; alias retains the original root and its current state, not a copied state snapshot
denseStaticProof.read: do not evaluate reads or RHS, do not reject/fold OOB reads, propagate caller constants, infer intervals or execute values; this is a proof of selected source dense invariants, not a guest interpreter
denseStaticProof.resize: for original literal newLength N and exact length L, reject N>L as statically proven uninitialized growth; otherwise on normal continuation set exact N. Literal resize from unknown also sets exact N only on normal continuation; its check remains. Parameter resize sets unknown.
denseStaticProof.store: for an original literal index and exact length L, reject index>L as a statically proven gap; index==L is allowed append and sets exact L+1 on normal continuation; index<L retains exact L. A parameter index sets unknown on normal continuation. Existing checked operation is always retained. An unknown prior length stays unknown for literal store.
